title: GrowthBook
description: Product-analytics calm: a near-white page with deep navy text, one brand violet for every solid button, pale lavender bands, navy and violet-black dark moments, and teal/mint as the second colour. Inter at regular weight for big airy headings, IBM Plex Mono for eyebrows.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the navy sections (testimonials, CTA card, footer, stats band) force themselves dark with the dark class
Inter and IBM Plex Mono are the original's own faces (both open licence)
